summary: No public author gene-level effects were located for the sex-adjusted preoptic isoflurane-versus-oxygen contrast in any registered population. GEO supplies counts, barcodes and feature annotations. The related sleep-study supplements concern a different experiment.

manualReview.summary: No public author gene-level results located for the preoptic isoflurane contrast
manualReview.note: The GEO archive contains 180 sample files spanning 20 mice. They contain feature annotations, nucleus barcodes and feature-by-nucleus counts. The series matrix has no gene rows. Searches by accession, title, contributor and experimental design located no author gene-level effects for isoflurane versus oxygen in any registered population. The related GSE243489 paper compares recovery sleep with undisturbed sleep.
reviewFlags: Author effect sizes, P values and FDR remain unassessed in excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons and non-neuronal cells.
